name: thinking-tools
description: Thinking-tool skills for harder, more honest AI assistance: board (adversarial multi-expert critique), premortem (name what could go wrong before committing to a plan), but-for-real (no success claims without actually running the thing), self-rate (grade your own draft before the user does), code-simplifier (clarity-preserving refactors of recent changes), weekly-automation-review (spot repetitive work worth automating), and commit-digest (pull applicable improvements from tracked external repos).
